rejected.text: Bretagard is the human realm of Kaldheim, home of the Skelle clan, where Kaya came from and where the battle for Kaldheim is fought.
Pages describe it as the realm where the events of the Kaldheim story occur, where Jutmaw lies, and the realm Kaya came from.
It is also where Niko joined the Kannah and the realm of the Skelle clan.
The final page calls it the human realm of Kaldheim where the battle is fought.
The latest page, in February 2021, shows Bretagard as the place where the battle for Kaldheim is fought.
